# Kbd

> Keyboard shortcut chip and chord group.

This file matches the installed `kbd` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/kbd.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/kbd.md`.

## Registry dependencies

- `core`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/kbd-knobs`: `kbdKnobs`, types `KbdKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/kbd`: `kbdVariants`, `Kbd`, `KbdGroup`, types `KbdVariant`, `KbdProps`, `KbdGroupProps`

## Composition

### Keyboard chord

```tsx
<KbdGroup>
  <Kbd />
</KbdGroup>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { Kbd, KbdGroup } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/kbd";
import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography";

export function PrimitiveKbdExample() {
  return (
    <Text as="div" tone="muted" className="flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col gap-6">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <span>Single key</span>
        <Kbd>Esc</Kbd>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <span>Command palette</span>
        <KbdGroup>
          <Kbd>⌘</Kbd>
          <Kbd>K</Kbd>
        </KbdGroup>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <span>Send message</span>
        <KbdGroup>
          <Kbd>⌘</Kbd>
          <Kbd>↵</Kbd>
        </KbdGroup>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <span>Inline hint</span>
        <Kbd variant="ghost">⌘K</Kbd>
      </div>
    </Text>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `kbd`
  - `group`
  - `root`: `data-variant` (`default` | `ghost`)

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### kbd

- `--cui-kbd-radius`: `var(--radius-control)`
- `--cui-kbd-background`: `oklch(from var(--card) l c h / 0.6)`
- `--cui-kbd-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)`
- `--cui-kbd-border-color`: `var(--control-rim)`
- `--cui-kbd-shadow`: `var(--shadow-sm)`
- `--cui-kbd-padding-inline`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 1.5)`
- `--cui-kbd-font-size`: `var(--text-micro)`
- `--cui-kbd-font-weight`: `var(--font-weight-medium)`
